accessibility_service_summary: Optional YouTube Shorts, feed and study-channel filters.
accessibility_service_description: FocusForge checks YouTube screen identifiers only when you enable Shorts or feed filters, to distinguish these screens from ordinary videos. When Study channels only is enabled, visible creator names or handles on supported video pages are compared with channels you selected. Screen checks stay on your device and visible labels are not retained or uploaded. While a YouTube pause is visible, application window package names are checked only to close the pause when you leave; other apps’ contents are not inspected. It does not read messages, passwords or text you type. Pause decisions and their times are saved only on this device for Shield insights. Access is optional and can be turned off in Android Settings. Normal app boundaries use Usage access and Draw over other apps; the focus timer works without any of these.
